messages:
Aisha (marketing): Heads-up: marketing needs validated benchmark numbers for the upcoming webinar and landing page. Can eng/runtime rerun the tests in s3://redwood-marketing/bench-q2/ and drop raw logs + a short CSV for copy by Friday?

Kevin (eng-runtime): I can run this. Which models and seqs to include? Cold and warm cache?

Aisha (marketing): Models: gpt-redwood-7b (fp16) + gpt-redwood-7b-q4_0 (int8). Seq lengths 64, 256, 1024. Batches 1 and 4. Both cold (clear KV) and warm (prefix cache). Use inputs list in the s3 folder.

Marta (eng-ml): Method notes: seed consistent, 100 warmup, 400 measured; report p50/p95/p99, tokens/sec (measured window), 95th memory, model load time separate. Flag kernel fallbacks.

Kevin (eng-runtime): Running on p4d test pool, release/v2.3 hash. Command and run_id posted to the run folder.

BenchmarkBot (bot): Run registered: run-20240310-7bcd, artifacts: s3://redwood-marketing/bench-q2/runs/run-20240310-7bcd/, status: started

Kevin (eng-runtime): Quick prelim: fp16 seq=64,batch=1 p95=28ms, tokens/sec=1180. seq=1024 shows occasional p99 spikes (~400ms) from attention kernel fallback; planning a longer rerun for seq=1024.

Marta (eng-ml): Please compute delta vs baseline run_id=run-20240115-golden and include percent changes; note if variance is high for q4.

BenchmarkBot (bot): Rerun complete: run-20240310-7bcd-rerun1. Artifacts uploaded. CSV summary added: marketing_summary.csv. Diff vs golden: p95 ~-1% (better), p99 +5% on long seq. q4: tokens/sec +10%, mem -4%, higher variance.

Kevin (eng-runtime): Recommendation: use p95 as the headline metric; include footnote about rare p99 long-seq outliers and link to raw logs. I added README and the exact commands to the run folder.

Sam (marketing): Great, please leave the CSV path and run_id in the marketing doc. I'll draft the one-line headline once I have the CSV link.

Aisha (marketing): Thanks everyone 44D. We'll use p95 for the landing page and reference run_id=run-20240310-7bcd-rerun1 for reproducibility.
